class.name: CSGBevelModifier
class.brief_description: Creates a flat bevel on sharp edges of generated CSG geometry.
class.description: Rebuilds generated CSG geometry by insetting adjacent faces, adding a chamfer along qualifying edges, and closing the resulting corners. Coplanar triangulation edges are ignored. Use [member application_mode] to bevel individual operands, newly created edges in the Boolean result, or both. The modifier creates a single flat bevel segment.

members.member: Controls whether the bevel is applied before or after Boolean operations. Use [constant APPLICATION_MODE_RESULT] to bevel edges created by subtraction and intersection operations.
Minimum angle in radians between neighboring faces for their shared edge to be beveled.
Distance in local units by which adjacent faces are inset from a beveled edge.

constants.constant: Applies the bevel independently to the owning shape and its child operands before the Boolean operation.
Applies the bevel to the final Boolean result. This includes edges created by subtraction and intersection operations.
Applies the bevel to operands and then applies it again to the Boolean result. This can bevel already generated chamfer edges a second time.
